decisions.reason: Correctly contrasts clipboard-text draft/Occurrence offsets with detect-coordinate TokenSpan verbs, chip = full clipboardText vs one U+FFFC, normal text/space width unchanged, citing both fixture files.

Locates snapshot.draft.length in add, shows empty-composer coincidence then 29-vs-2 overshoot making the detect splice fail so insertReference returns false and the generic toast fires; explicitly rules out a real concurrent edit and a failing rev guard.

Traces remove: unconverted clipboard span [0,28) to consumeToken, ignored false, unconditional records.delete; occurrence remains, record-missing renders unavailable, both tied to the same coordinate mismatch.

Derives detectOffset = offset − Σ(len−1); insert uses detect end over all preceding occurrences, removal maps offset then a 1-detect-char span; keeps draftRev guard and gates records.delete on the verb's true return, with correct pseudocode.

Proposes double paste with both chips present (T2/T3) and removal of first/second chip with the other surviving (T8/T9), asserting composer occurrence, dock chip and record removed together plus declined-consumption bookkeeping variants (T10).
